knowledge:
- key_parameters: model=Specifies the genetic mode of inheritance in tdt() ("additive", "dominant", or "recessive") ;; test=Specifies the interaction test type in tdtGxG() ("screen", "lrt", "full", or the default epistatic test) ;; genes=A vector in colGxG() assigning SNPs to genes/blocks to prevent testing interactions between linked SNPs ;; is.linkage=A logical in trio.check() indicating if input is in pedigree/linkage format (TRUE) or genotype format (FALSE) ;; replace=A logical in trio.check() to replace genotypes causing Mendelian errors with NA ;; blocks=A vector of block lengths in trio.prepare() for haplotype estimation (currently ignored if haplo.stats is missing) ;; logic=A logical in trio.prepare() where FALSE returns completed genotype data in the original format instead of binary format ;; freq=A data frame of haplotype frequencies in trio.prepare() to bypass automatic haplotype estimation ;; control=A list of control parameters for trioLR() and trioFS() generated by lrControl() ;; search=Specifies the search algorithm in trioLR() ("sa" for simulated annealing, "greedy", or "mcmc") ;; parentsOnly=A logical in getLD() and findLDblocks() to restrict LD calculations to parents only to avoid transmission bias
- alternatives: Score tests (scoreTDT, scoreMaxStat, scoreGxG, scoreGxE) can be used instead of Wald-based gTDTs (colTDT, etc.) for faster computation, though they do not provide odds ratios, relative risks, or confidence intervals ;; trioFS (trio Feature Selection) can be preferred over trioLR to stabilize the search for relevant SNP interactions using bagging
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing case-parent trio genetic data to identify disease-associated SNPs, two-way or higher-order SNP-SNP interactions, or gene-environment interactions while controlling for population stratification
- pitfalls: Mendelian errors must be resolved or replaced with NA (using replace=TRUE in trio.check) before running trio.prepare or logic regression ;; Testing interactions between SNPs in strong LD (linked loci) can cause conditional logistic regression fitting to fail in colGxG or tdtGxG; use the genes argument to avoid testing linked SNPs ;; The blocks argument in trio.prepare is ignored if the haplo.stats package is unavailable; use the freq argument to supply haplotype frequencies manually

workflows.name: standard_tdt_association_testing
workflows.intent: Test individual SNPs, two-way SNP interactions, and gene-environment interactions using genotypic TDT, allelic TDT, or score tests.
input: pedigree_data.ped (pedigree file containing family structure and SNP alleles)
environmental_covariates.txt (binary environmental variable for GxE testing)
workflows.stages: 1. Format pedigree IDs and convert pedigree data to a genotype matrix using ped2geno ;; 2. Run single SNP gTDT under additive, dominant, or recessive models using tdt ;; 3. Perform high-throughput single SNP testing using colTDT ;; 4. Run MAX tests to find the best genetic model using colTDTmaxStat and colTDTmaxTest ;; 5. Test two-way SNP interactions using tdtGxG or colGxG ;; 6. Test gene-environment interactions using colGxE and extract statistics using getGxEstats ;; 7. Run allelic TDT using allelicTDT or score tests using scoreTDT
workflows.code:
library(trio)
data(trio.data)
trio.ped1[,2] <- paste(trio.ped1[,1], trio.ped1[,2], sep="_")
ids <- trio.ped1[,3] != 0
trio.ped1[ids,3] <- paste(trio.ped1[ids,1], trio.ped1[ids,3], sep="_")
trio.ped1[ids,4] <- paste(trio.ped1[ids,1], trio.ped1[ids,4], sep="_")
geno <- ped2geno(trio.ped1)
tdt(mat.test[,1])
tdt(mat.test[,1], model="dominant")
tdt(mat.test[,1], model="recessive")
tdtGxG(mat.test[,1], mat.test[,2])
tdtGxG(mat.test[,1], mat.test[,2], test="screen")
tdt.out <- colTDT(mat.test)
print(tdt.out, 3)
max.stat <- colTDTmaxStat(mat.test)
max.out <- colTDTmaxTest(mat.test, perm=1000)
genes <- paste("G", rep(1:2, c(2,4)), sep="")
tdt2.out <- colGxG(mat.test, genes=genes)
sex <- rep(0:1, e=50)
gxe.out <- colGxE(mat.test, sex)
dat.top3 <- getGxEstats(gxe.out, top=3, sortBy="lrt2df")
a.out <- allelicTDT(mat.test)
a.out2 <- allelicTDT(mat.test, correct=TRUE)
s.out <- scoreTDT(mat.test)

workflows.name: trio_logic_regression_and_feature_selection
workflows.intent: Identify higher-order SNP interactions associated with disease risk using trio logic regression and bagging-based feature selection.
input: pedigree_data.ped (pedigree file containing family structure and SNP alleles)
haplotype_frequencies.txt (optional pre-estimated haplotype frequencies for imputation)
workflows.stages: 1. Check for Mendelian errors and format data using trio.check, optionally replacing errors with NA ;; 2. Prepare binary data and impute missing genotypes using trio.prepare ;; 3. Set up logic regression control parameters using lrControl ;; 4. Fit trio logic regression models using trioLR with simulated annealing, greedy, or MCMC search ;; 5. Run feature selection using trioFS to identify and rank important interactions
workflows.code:
library(trio)
data(trio.data)
trio.tmp <- trio.check(dat=trio.ped1)
set.seed(123456)
trio.bin <- trio.prepare(trio.dat=trio.tmp, blocks=c(1,4,2,3))
trio.rep <- trio.check(dat=trio.ped.err, replace=TRUE)
trio.imp3 <- trio.prepare(trio.dat=trio.tmp, freq=freq.hap, logic=FALSE)
my.control <- lrControl(start=1, end=-3, iter=1000, output=-4)
lr.out <- trioLR(trio.bin, control=my.control, rand=9876543)
print(lr.out, asDNF=TRUE)
lr.out3 <- trioLR(trio.bin, nleaves=c(3,5), control=my.control, rand=9876543)
lr.out4 <- trioLR(trio.bin, search="greedy", rand=9876543)
lr.out5 <- trioLR(trio.bin, search="mcmc", control=my.control, rand=9876543)
fs.out <- trioFS(trio.bin, B=5, control=my.control, rand=1234)

workflows.name: ld_block_detection
workflows.intent: Compute pairwise linkage disequilibrium (LD) measures and identify LD blocks in genotype data.
input: genotype_matrix.txt (matrix of genotypes where columns are SNPs and rows are individuals)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute pairwise D' and r2 values using getLD ;; 2. Estimate LD blocks using findLDblocks
workflows.code:
library(trio)
ld.out <- getLD(LDdata, asMatrix=TRUE)
blocks <- findLDblocks(LDdata)
ld.out2 <- getLD(LDdata, addVarN=TRUE)
blocks2 <- findLDblocks(ld.out2)
